[Benzinga news, 2026-10-22T11:32:47Z, by staff] Curbline Properties Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results and Raises 2026 Outlook
Curbline Properties announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results, reporting revenue of $71.1 million and operating FFO of $0.32 per share, while raising its full-year 2026 operating FFO outlook.
Curbline Properties reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $71.1 million, exceeding the FactSet consensus estimate of $66.5 million. The company posted operating FFO of $0.32 per share, which was in line with analyst expectations. Additionally, the company raised its full-year 2026 operating FFO per share guidance to a range of $1.25 to $1.27. These results reflect the company's performance as a self-managed REIT focused on convenience shopping centers.

reasoning: Source: Curbline's Q3 release (Benzinga 10:31 UTC: 'Curbline Properties Raises FY2026 FFO Guidance from $1.24-$1.26 to $1.25-$1.27 vs $1.25 Est'; 11:32 UTC write-up via MarketScreener).
Quoted: 'operating FFO of $0.32 per share, which was in line with analyst expectations'; revenue '$71.1 million, exceeding the FactSet consensus estimate of $66.5 million'.
What changed: the full-year FFO midpoint moves from $1.25 to $1.26, $0.01 above consensus. For a REIT, FFO is the number that counts, and it is in line.
objections: In-line FFO and a one-cent guidance raise; no surprise.
